scope: Complete Windows 11 AMD64 filesystem/helper/driver; effective AMD GPU acceleration, independent CPU recovery, high sustained throughput, exceptional lossless reduction, autonomous low-impact persistent learning and verified resilience.

owner_safety.gpu: tiny synthetic only after exact-source isolated qualification and audited hard limits
owner_safety.staging: small source/tool/report staging only on verified authorized HDD, never filesystem backing

continuation: Read AGENTS and this ledger; verify actual main and source-bound CI before selecting work.
Take first dependency-ready unfinished package; G01 is next implementation, D01 may progress independently without delegation.
Read applicable boundary docs and current primary sources before important changes; use mandatory semantic and Crawl4AI providers.
Implement a bounded substantive change, qualify in isolated environments, retain failures and update evidence in a coherent main commit.
Complete packages only when their exit criteria are met. Keep the existing full goal active; no new goal, thread, scheduled task or inferred delegation.

packages.title: Keep authoritative evidence and an executable continuation plan
deliverables: Refresh the stale state ledger, preserve historical qualification and publish this source-bound assessment and plan.

Record compact phase evidence, exact source hashes and changed-scope reads as the continuation method. Record secure immutable candidate qualification as a future CI efficiency investigation; no CI gate is changed by this publication.
validation: Validate JSON, dependency DAG, referenced source identities and tree changes; preserve LICENSE, workflows and owner edits.
Record the plan publication separately from runtime implementation. Do not mark future packages complete.
packages.exit: The assessment, plan and current state are published coherently on main and the next implementation package is explicit.

packages.title: Admit useful GPU work with live resource envelopes
deliverables: Define one shared memory/admission contract for worker, core result gate and match controller. Collect current physical and commit headroom, both DXGI segment budgets/usages, workload footprint, identity and freshness.

Derive bounded envelopes from those observations and independently enforced safety limits. Distinguish supported temporary resource pressure from unknown device faults; preserve immediate CPU-byte selection, event/evidence-driven retry, quiescence and terminal per-request behavior.
Keep the current batch bounds and independent CPU comparison. Do not hardcode this owner's GPU, RAM, drive, observed 176.6/12.2 MiB usage or capacities.
validation: Table-driven fake-API cases: missing/stale/overflow telemetry, shrinking budgets, concurrent pressure, unified/shared memory, identity changes, faulty device, cancellation and incomplete retirement.
Exercise all three admission sites with identical cases; raw-only, codec, sanitizers, Windows native/worker fixtures and SDK compilation.
After exact-source disposable-VM qualification and harness audit, at most a tiny synthetic owner test with confirmed cleanup. No unchanged retries.
packages.exit: A bounded successful candidate is admitted when justified by fresh evidence; every unknown or unsafe case returns independently verified CPU bytes without repeated device searches. This is not proof of native compression speed.

checkpoint.behavior: Shared resource envelope, allocating-process physical/commit telemetry and original-baseline growth policy implemented in the publishing commit.
checkpoint.qualification: Pending exact-source CPU/raw/sanitizer/Windows/SDK results; no owner GPU run of the new policy.
checkpoint.remaining: Qualify implementation, audit harness, then a tiny actual accepted result; full CPU/GPU/load governor remains A01.

packages.title: Resolve intermittent hosted writer/child retirement failures
deliverables: Add bounded phase, wait, cancellation and process/job ownership evidence to isolated crash and crash-restart fixtures.
Reproduce the observed 15-second operation plus 2-second unconfirmed-exit behavior. Inspect acknowledgement, dispatcher-stop, pipe/object ownership and cancellation order without assuming a deadlock.
Fix the cause and guarantee cleanup/retirement ordering or explicit terminal failure; retain bounded logs.
validation: Regression must fail for the observed cause and pass after the fix; repeat the affected isolated scenarios with bounded resource accounting.
Verify cancellation at every owned lifecycle phase and absence of stale workers/handles/locked pages. A green rerun or longer timeout alone is insufficient.
packages.exit: The earlier failures are explained by captured evidence and a targeted regression; repeated isolated qualification confirms child exit and cleanup.

packages.title: Connect qualified GPU work to native filesystem compression
deliverables: Qualify the actual match-proposal to native lossless encode route and map which native formats have genuine GPU execution.
Retain immutable input, CPU-readable encoded output and byte-exact independent verification. Unsupported codecs and runtime faults select CPU immediately.
validation: Mixed synthetic and bounded public real data: offsets, truncations, overlaps, malformed proposals, incompressible bytes and corruption.
Separate CPU emulation, SDK compilation, actual kernel execution, result admission and filesystem use in reports.
Measure complete cold and warm write/read paths, output image bytes, metadata, validation, transfers and fallback costs.
packages.exit: A native filesystem operation demonstrably uses GPU work with exact recovery and measured end-to-end benefit in stated conditions; otherwise retain CPU routing and record why.

packages.title: Reduce GPU pipeline overhead while preserving containment
deliverables: Instrument process/runtime/context/module startup, transfer, kernel, comparison, native encode and retirement separately.

Research and compare safe amortization, bounded batching and verification strategies. A resident worker or relaxed batch cap requires a reviewed replacement lifecycle/security contract and equivalent fault containment before implementation.
validation: Matched alternating cold/warm CPU/GPU trials with confidence/noise reporting, responsiveness and live resource evidence.
Test shutdown/cancel/driver disappearance in isolated VMs or mocks only; never stress owner WDDM or leave idle workers without a justified bounded lifecycle.
packages.exit: Measured whole-operation gains survive the safety and correctness gates; no optimization depends on omitting integrity checks or unbounded persistent processes.

packages.title: Scale the store and namespace with bounded incremental work
deliverables: Design scalable object/extent indexes, allocator, incremental checksums, history reclamation and reader pins. Preserve old wire compatibility or provide an explicit verified migration path.
Replace whole-state work where measurements justify it; distinguish sparse logical sizes from allocated bytes and enforce quotas/reserves.
validation: Small-RAM sparse/mock backends exercise large logical address spaces, adversarial indexes, interrupted allocation/reclamation and reader pin races.
Legacy CPU reader, create-new output, capacity exhaustion, rollback and independent recovery tests; no giant owner images.
packages.exit: Explicit scaling targets and measured resource bounds pass without merely increasing constants or abandoning recovery.

packages.title: Persist bounded crash-safe optimization state
deliverables: Define a small accounted internal area for workload summaries, policy versions, confidence and bounded benchmark history, writable only through controlled helper/driver transactions.
Treat advisory learning state as rebuildable. Dictionaries/models required to decode data are immutable referenced format objects with their own integrity, retention and durability rules.
Specify size caps, wear/write budget, transactional publication, rollback and eviction before adding any learner.
validation: Torn writes at every commit boundary, stale/unsupported policy, corrupt records, full reserved area and interrupted compaction.
Recovery preserves acknowledged user data; damaged advisory state safely rebuilds, while missing decode-critical objects are detected and recovered only from verified redundancy.
packages.exit: A CPU-readable bounded optimization area survives the defined fault model without making data readability depend on a mutable learned model.

packages.title: Discover capabilities and govern foreground/background resources
deliverables: Discover supported CPU features, processor availability, live CPU/GPU pressure, physical/commit/VRAM headroom and storage characteristics without installation-path or owner-hardware assumptions.

Use a bounded event/evidence-driven governor with low-priority CPU/I/O/GPU work, small admitted units, cooperative yield, fairness and bounded debt. Timers may bound operations but cannot substitute for a retry or idle decision policy.
Resolve missing optional dependencies safely in verified private locations where permitted; no global driver/package changes, elevation, services or silent unsupported runtime substitution.
validation: Mock heterogeneous CPUs/GPUs, no GPU, unknown metrics, foreground load, budget changes, suspend/resume and multiple volumes.
Measure actual foreground interference and immediate yield; enforce hard process-tree memory/CPU/time limits and confirmed cleanup.
packages.exit: The same OS/architecture runs without host-specific paths/specs; unknown headroom fails closed and background work obeys a documented bounded interference budget.

packages.title: Select foreground compression from measured benefit
deliverables: Choose useful fast lossless compression on writes; use stronger GPU-assisted work only when measured throughput, resources and reduction justify it.
Maintain a bounded codec/transform portfolio with raw fallback for incompressible data. Optimize physical bytes, sustained reads/writes, read/write amplification and resource cost together.
Research current official APIs and recent relevant primary papers before each important algorithm/format change; evaluate competing candidates rather than copying archive software.
validation: Held-out mixed workload evaluation with cold/warm reads, partial writes and pressure; include codec metadata/dictionaries/history in ratio.
All encoded forms have bounded decoders, malicious-input rejection and independent CPU recovery.
packages.exit: Foreground policy improves the published throughput/reduction tradeoff over the fixed baseline on held-out workloads, with safe degradation under load.

packages.title: Learn workload policies and run bounded idle microbenchmarks
deliverables: Implement a local bounded learner over content/workload features, measured encode/decode costs and confidence; include concept drift, version/source identity and reproducible policy decisions.
Trigger small experiments when fresh resource/work evidence supports them, prioritizing useful uncertainty reduction rather than a fixed maintenance timer.
Track evaluated image/generation/profile identities and future measurable benefit. Preserve duplicate-work suppression and avoid endless rewrites.
validation: Deterministic policy tests, cold-start/fallback, corrupt learning state, workload shifts, adversarial observations and repeated no-benefit samples.
Compare against fixed/simple adaptive baselines; bound memory, exploration work, writes and actual foreground interference.
packages.exit: Learning persists safely and shows held-out benefit over simpler policies without changing correctness or consuming uncontrolled resources.

packages.title: Collectively optimize cold data and layout
deliverables: Investigate shared dictionaries, duplicate/near-duplicate representations, content transforms and layout/defragmentation against current primary research and relevant baselines.
Run bounded incremental candidates, verify complete CPU readback, publish transactionally and retain source until reader pins and durability permit reclamation.
Account for metadata, recovery replicas, dictionaries, temporary candidates and read amplification; stop negative-benefit work and yield promptly.
validation: Concurrent readers/writers, cancellation, resource pressure, interrupted handoff/reclamation, capacity failure and recovery.
Real heterogeneous held-out corpora plus incompressible/adversarial data; report total image size and steady-state performance, not payload-only ratios.
packages.exit: Unattended collective optimization produces verified net gains without manual intervention, runaway rewrites or material foreground disruption.

packages.title: Qualify payload repair and acknowledged-write durability
deliverables: Define failure domains, acknowledgement/barrier ordering, payload redundancy, checksums, journal/root selection and independent CPU recovery.
Implement corruption localization and verified source-preserving repair. Report irrecoverable loss instead of synthesizing bytes; distinguish metadata repair from payload recovery.
validation: Deterministic fault injection at every persist boundary, short/torn/reordered writes, corrupted replicas, OOM, kill and candidate publication.
Use disposable VM/backend models for crash tests. Physical power-loss claims need matching storage/barrier qualification elsewhere; owner RAM tests cannot provide it.
packages.exit: The explicit fault model and acknowledgement contract pass independent recovery with no unexplained lost acknowledged bytes. Universal survival of arbitrary bugs or loss of all copies is not a claim.

packages.title: Complete Windows semantics and helper/application lifecycle
deliverables: Complete request-bound authority, owner/group, ACL/inheritance, sharing/locking, notifications, cancellation, mapped I/O and unresolved-session recovery matrices.
Build the helper/app and installation/update/uninstall lifecycle with independent CPU recovery and host-agnostic dependency discovery.
Qualify latest supported Windows 11 AMD64 client VMs and the selected driver integration; preserve separate mounting gates.
validation: Read-only disposable fixture first, then isolated writable tests with strict existing caps; no owner driver installation or mounted host probe.
Verify crash/restart, upgrades/rollback, no stale services/workers/tasks/handles and safe uninstallation without touching unrelated files.
packages.exit: Published Windows capability matrix and reproducible client qualification cover the promised app/driver behaviors; hosted callback success alone is insufficient.

packages.title: Security and independent comparative qualification
deliverables: Review threat model, parser/decoder limits, package/runtime provenance, update trust and current Dependabot alerts. Define encryption/authentication/key recovery explicitly before advertising security features.
Use appropriate recognized benchmarks and reproducible mixed real corpora against several current filesystem/compression baselines with equivalent durability/resource settings.
Publish failures, noise, unsupported data/operations, total physical costs and exact source/tool/host identities. The owner alone decides release.
validation: Malicious/corrupt input, fuzzing, OOM, partial writes, downgrade/compatibility and independent CPU recovery.
Repeated alternating trials and held-out corpora; separate RAM-backed logical performance from physical-media and power-loss results. No owner raw-device or physical backing tests.
packages.exit: Claims match reproducible evidence and unresolved blockers are disclosed. No selected result establishes universal superiority over every filesystem.

publication_note: P00 is completed by the commit publishing this ledger; runtime packages remain pending. The reviewed baseline identifies evidence before this documentation/assets commit.
